name: bb10-volte
scope: All 16 catalog entries admit Mobile 460-00/07, Unicom 460-01 and Telecom 460-11 regardless of evidence status. Root, OS 10.3.3.3216, native ABI hashes, SIM identity, backup and recovery requirements remain. r45/mobile 0.1.0.45 unifies incoming-call SIP/SDP signaling across Telecom, Unicom and Mobile in the temporary IMS copy (MediaDialog.EarlySdp=0 to suppress repeated or unreliable preview SDP in 180 Ringing, and MediaDialog.Omit200OkSdp=0 to preserve the RFC 3261 SDP answer in 200 OK when no reliable 18x completed offer/answer while precondition calls keep an empty 200 OK). Previously published r42/r43/r44 service payloads remain eligible for checked in-place upgrade after stopping VoLTE. Historical tested, untested and known-issue results stay version-specific; regional incoming-call compatibility awaits field testing and is not claimed as hardware-accepted by offline emulation. macOS remains the frozen r43 build.
